Although memory costs are expected to easily become the most expensive part of the iPhone 18 Pro bill of materials, the situation for the iPhone Duo may not be the same. Here are the relevant details.

Apple Signs Three-Year Exclusive Deal with Samsung Display

Leaker Instant Digital posted on Weibo today stating that Apple and Samsung Display have signed a three-year exclusive supply agreement for foldable panels.

According to this leaker, Samsung Display will be the exclusive supplier of foldable panels for the iPhone Duo "and subsequent models," with each panel costing approximately US$250.

The leaker also pointed out that this component is, "unsurprisingly," one of the "most expensive core components" of the device.

Although there is currently no reliable estimate of the iPhone Duo's bill of materials, by breaking down the costs of the display, camera, processor, memory, and other components, Apple has shared some interesting information about the materials used in the device, including how much recycled material is contained.
